warning: These are manual/authorized harness checks, not automated product test results.

cases.title: Existing code, summary and guidance survive
cases.setup: Use a Failed QA job with a saved technical reason and a same-record baseline of the existing summary/code/guidance.
steps: Read the manager saved message and call the real Studio Backend through authorized access.
Compare the original properties against the same job after details exposure.
Open its Studio failure view and inspect Error details as well as existing guidance.
cases.expected: Sanitized saved details are added without replacing or changing the same job's existing code, summary or troubleshooting guidance. A baseline from a different run is not equivalent evidence.
cases.evidence: Record environment/build, app/crawler/job IDs, redacted API evidence, UI result and Pass / Fail / Blocked. Do not put real credentials into this site.

cases.title: Empty messages after a populated failure
cases.setup: Prepare failed QA records for SM12, SM13, SM14 and SM16, plus a failed record with visible details.
steps: Open the record with meaningful details first.
Navigate to each absent/null/empty/whitespace record.
Wait for the selected record's request to complete and inspect the API and DOM.
cases.expected: No empty heading/panel, stale previous message, literal undefined, perpetual spinner or loading error; the existing summary/guidance stays visible. Confirm the whitespace policy with Product.
cases.evidence: Record environment/build, app/crawler/job IDs, redacted API evidence, UI result and Pass / Fail / Blocked. Do not put real credentials into this site.

cases.title: Failure A to B to no-details record
cases.setup: Prepare three distinguishable QA job IDs: A with qa_number_i, B with qa_published_dt, C with no saved message.
steps: Open A, then B, then C using Studio navigation.
Return to A and reload B directly.
Check each response/job identity and the displayed field names.
cases.expected: Each page shows only the selected job's details. C does not inherit A/B text. Returning to a failed job retrieves its own historical message.
cases.evidence: Record environment/build, app/crawler/job IDs, redacted API evidence, UI result and Pass / Fail / Blocked. Do not put real credentials into this site.

cases.title: Recovery does not rewrite historical failure
cases.setup: Use FD03 or FD04 in a dedicated QA crawler with a reproducible failed run.
steps: Record the failed job ID, code, summary and sanitized saved details.
Run the corresponding fixed URL with compatible mappings/schema as a new job.
Confirm successful recovery, then revisit the old failed job.
cases.expected: The fixed run does not fabricate a failure panel. The previous failed run retains its own historical details. Updating a crawler configuration does not relabel the old failure as the new outcome.
cases.evidence: Record environment/build, app/crawler/job IDs, redacted API evidence, UI result and Pass / Fail / Blocked. Do not put real credentials into this site.

cases.title: Out-of-order responses while switching runs
cases.setup: Use an approved staging UI test harness/network interceptor to delay job A's details response. No origin URL can create this race reliably.
steps: Open A and hold its response.
Navigate to B and deliver B's response first.
Release A's delayed response while B remains selected.
cases.expected: A's stale response never overwrites B. The selected run ID, summary, code and details remain aligned; no indefinite loading indicator.
cases.evidence: Record environment/build, app/crawler/job IDs, redacted API evidence, UI result and Pass / Fail / Blocked. Do not put real credentials into this site.

cases.title: Details retrieval failure and retry
cases.setup: Use an authorized harness to simulate a network error or denied/unavailable response on the actual relevant API.
steps: Load an authorized failed job, then trigger the supported details-request failure mode.
Observe the error/loading state and use the supported retry action, if available.
Restore a valid response and verify the selected job's details load.
cases.expected: No stale or secret-bearing fallback details. If summary/guidance are independently loaded, keep them usable. If the whole record request fails, use the product-approved error state rather than falsely showing a healthy/empty record. Exact retry UI/status contract requires Engineering agreement.
cases.evidence: Record environment/build, app/crawler/job IDs, redacted API evidence, UI result and Pass / Fail / Blocked. Do not put real credentials into this site.

cases.title: Legacy failed record without the new property
cases.setup: Use an older failed test record where status_message is absent; do not merely set it to an empty value.
steps: Read the older record via the new Studio Backend.
Load its history entry, then refresh or reopen the page.
Compare the visible legacy code, summary and guidance.
cases.expected: Backward compatibility: no serialization failure, blank Error details section or loading error. Existing troubleshooting content still explains the failure.
cases.evidence: Record environment/build, app/crawler/job IDs, redacted API evidence, UI result and Pass / Fail / Blocked. Do not put real credentials into this site.

cases.title: Account, application and role isolation
cases.setup: Use two authorized QA accounts/apps and test users with known permitted/denied access. Never probe customer records.
steps: Read a failed job as a user allowed to access it.
Switch to the other app/account or the designated non-authorized test user and request the same QA job through the normal UI/API.
Inspect the response and any cached details.
cases.expected: Existing authorization boundaries also protect technical details. Denied access must not expose the previous account's message. Use the product's established unauthorized/not-found behavior; this case does not prescribe a new status code.
cases.evidence: Record environment/build, app/crawler/job IDs, redacted API evidence, UI result and Pass / Fail / Blocked. Do not put real credentials into this site.

cases.title: Direct link, reload and session restoration
cases.setup: Use a known failed QA run with a stable saved message and the product's normal authentication flow.
steps: Open the failed-run URL directly, then reload.
Repeat after a normal logout/login cycle with the same authorized user.
Compare the selected app/crawler/job and sanitized details.
cases.expected: The normal authentication flow is retained. The correct failed run and sanitized details load without requiring prior navigation or stale browser state.
cases.evidence: Record environment/build, app/crawler/job IDs, redacted API evidence, UI result and Pass / Fail / Blocked. Do not put real credentials into this site.

cases.title: Long text, mobile width, zoom and keyboard
cases.setup: Use SM10, SM17, SM28, SM29 and SM31 in the real Studio view.
steps: Inspect the actual details DOM for message-created markup or executable links.
Review at a narrow mobile width and 200% zoom; navigate all relevant controls by keyboard.
Check wrapping/contained scrolling and the product-approved truncation/expand behavior.
cases.expected: Text-only rendering; no script/markup creation. Long content does not hide the summary/guidance or make navigation unusable. Do not require an expand control if the product design does not have one.
cases.evidence: Record environment/build, app/crawler/job IDs, redacted API evidence, UI result and Pass / Fail / Blocked. Do not put real credentials into this site.

cases.title: Copy or export must not reintroduce raw secrets
cases.setup: Use SM07, SM23, SM32 and SM39. Apply only if the actual product provides a copy/export/share action for details.
steps: Copy/export using the actual supported control.
Inspect the resulting text/file locally in the authorized QA environment.
Compare with the sanitized API response and verify all synthetic markers are absent.
cases.expected: Copied/exported text is sanitized too; a safe visible panel must not conceal an unsafe raw clipboard value. Mark Not applicable if no such feature exists; the ticket does not require adding one.
cases.evidence: Record environment/build, app/crawler/job IDs, redacted API evidence, UI result and Pass / Fail / Blocked. Do not put real credentials into this site.

cases.title: Check all response properties, not just the panel
cases.setup: Run a synthetic secret case through the real backend, with authorized access to capture the frontend-facing response.
steps: Inspect the entire JSON response including debug/nested properties, not only the selected details path.
Use the supplied checker on the capture, including the real property path and a same-run baseline.
Inspect the actual rendered DOM separately; do not use the fixture's safe preview as evidence.
cases.expected: No raw duplicate or encoded synthetic credential in a secondary response property. The displayed field/reason remains useful. The checker can validate known canaries only; UI and source-provenance checks remain separate.
cases.evidence: Record environment/build, app/crawler/job IDs, redacted API evidence, UI result and Pass / Fail / Blocked. Do not put real credentials into this site.
